title: Chapter 717
paragraphs: Chapter 717
Episode 180. Individual Battles (7)
The moment Mon's sword started to shake the entire fortress, putting pressure on the Myu sisters, Mary paused for a moment and turned back.
‘That's the energy of a Black Knight at minimum. Has Sir Mon arrived to support those Tona guys?’
She felt an increase in the roars and with it, the intensified vibration that was transmitted to the fortress.
It was evidence that the reinforcement troops of the temporary alliance had arrived.
Therefore, Mary decided it was best to wait for her allies to arrive and move together, so she halted her infiltration.
There was no need to take unnecessary risks.
Although she had been eager to find out the internal situation as soon as possible, if she now made a mistake alone, it could turn out to be a hindrance to her allies.
The hostages trapped in the fortress, the Prophet, the Tona brothers and the allies' struggle, Jin and Diphus, who were known to have moved somewhere to start a fight.
Although there were countless factors making her impatient, Mary calmly turned her body.
She planned to go towards the entrance of the fortress to wait for her allies.
However, Mary soon sighed, entwining her whip with the venomous snake.
Glop, glop... The sight of a black robe approaching from the end of the corridor came into view.
“Yeah, things couldn't possibly go as planned. Ilina... no, Prophet. As expected, you came to greet me.”
[Well, the 7th generation of the family came to find Licalton. It would be appropriate for me, the lord, to personally greet you, right?]
Swish-!
The venomous snake stretched out like a whip, trying to sweep Ilina away.
‘An illusion...? It doesn't touch.’
Just like bending water, Ilina seemed to waver for a moment but did not receive any damage at all. It was the same even when attacked again.
“What kind of law is it in any country to play such tricks and then formally greet me? Is it the law of chaos?”
Ilina grinned, clapping her hands.
[No, I’ve really prepared a lot for you. So don't be too upset. You'll definitely be surprised.]

"Heh heh! Listen, Prophet. Our allies have already surrounded the outside. Moreover, we know that the monster cannot move, and the 4th generation is said to be luring Jin into a fight. You may seem relaxed, but I can see everything. Are you scared because things seem to be going awry?”
[Does it look that way?]
“I'm sure your original plan was to prevent the allies from reaching this fortress at all. But they've arrived, albeit later than planned, and you've set up an illusion for safety.”
[Regrettably, you pose no threat to me. So, the illusion for safety is a testament to your excessive confidence. This is not just an illusion.]
“Are you going to send more giants? Or activate some sort of trap to try and kill me? Whatever you've prepared, go ahead and do it. You guys are bound to lose today.”
[If I wanted to kill you, there would be no need for traps.]
“Then come out and face me.”
[There is someone else who will kill you.]
“What?”
[12th generation Jin Runcandel, he will be the one to kill you.]
Mary scoffs.

“Jin is different from the others. He, like the Myu sisters outside, like the other armies of chaos, like Rosa, like the 4th generation... will never fall. You guys can't even begin to imagine how special he is, how strong he is.”
[Diphus said the exact same thing. Sigh, it should have been you or the 4th or 12th generation instead of trash like Joshua who became one of us.]

“It seems you haven’t completely lost your senses, even though you've fallen. The 4th generation would also know, they can't defeat Jin. The youngest is not someone you or the 4th generation can handle. If you want to catch him, you have to bring the monster, and even that will ultimately fail!”
[Then, why did Diphus lure the 12th generation knowing he would lose?]
“He must be buying time until the monster can move. Just like you guys have been doing.”
[Half-right answer. 7th generation, before the battle began today... I'll tell you what Diphus ordered me.]
Even if I fall, make sure Runcandel does not.
Continuing her words, Ilina removed her hood.
[The 12th flagbearer doesn’t necessarily have to accept chaos to harm you. From the start, Diphus didn’t even consider making him fall. Instead, like this...]
The moment Ilina got to that point, Mary hastily stepped back, swinging her venomous snake.
A huge surge of energy suddenly sprouted from the void and engulfed her.
‘This is...!’
It was energy manipulation.
Moreover, it was imbued with Jin's distinct powerful force.
Aside from the Demon King clan, Jin was the only human capable of handling this kind of energy manipulation.
Moreover, that was just the beginning.
Before she knew it, energy manipulation was spreading all around.
No matter how many times she checked, it was undoubtedly Jin's energy.

[...without even knowing it, he's the one who ends up killing you. All the energy wasted while fighting with Diphus has been arranged to strike this place right now. Both Diphus and I have done it. A variation of the authority of dimensional teleportation, shall we say?]
"Guh!"
Mary, pushed back by the energy manipulation, clenched her teeth.

[As you said, when the monarch is absent, it's not easy for us to gain the upper hand in a battle of firepower, right? So, we prepared diligently. Even if the 12th flagbearer does not fall, they can't avoid falling into the abyss of despair!]
As Mary said, Jin never falls.
Diphus realized this fact a long time ago and admitted that he couldn't defeat him while he was injured by the eternity.
So Diphus approached in a completely different way.
As everyone knows.
Now, apart from the monster, Jin was virtually the strongest. Even warriors like Mary could barely hold on for a few minutes in a real fight with Jin.
Such an attack by Jin was plummeting in Lycalton's inner fortress.
Only a few seconds had passed, but the corridor where Mary was standing was already destroyed beyond recognition.
How is this possible?
She didn’t have the luxury to worry about that. It felt like a dull surge was sweeping through her head.
Of course, not a single person among the allies had anticipated this situation.
She is going to die.
And that too, by the youngest's power.
Even if that happened, Mary had no intention of blaming Jin, but the weight of the despair he would have to bear was beyond description.
'In addition, it's not just me dying, if this continues, the other comrades will also be hit by the youngest's energy!'
Right now, Jin's energy was only spreading towards the inner fortress.
However, it was unknown how long the range would be limited to the inner fortress. If Jin's energy spreads to the outer fortress, and beyond the battlefield.
Tens of thousands of prisoners would be slaughtered, and there would be a large number of casualties among the allies.
After the battle, Jin would hear all about it.
'No matter how strong the youngest is, if he experiences such a thing...!'
He will break.
He can only break. No one could survive unscathed after going through such a thing.
The survivors, especially the comrades, would tell him that it's not his fault.
But Jin could never think like that.
"Huh, Guk...!"
Zzzzzip-!
A part of the energy manipulation achieved by the ninth sword of the god-slaying swords struck Mary down.
She barely managed to block it, but her collarbone was broken, and hot blood burst out from her throat.
Irina licked her lips as if she was quite satisfied with the sight.

[How about it, do you still think you can win? Do you think I'm worried that things will go wrong? I am a prophet. What I said, eventually comes true. Today, Jin Runcandel is going to kill a lot of people.]
She was done for.
Mary had no choice but to admit that. No breakthrough was visible.
All she could do was to block the energy manipulation.
But for some reason.
Mary felt as if the fear and concern for Jin that filled her mind was suddenly washed away. Just like the moment when believers hear the voice of God at the brink of despair.
Great beings often give groundless faith at such times.
Mary realized that she had regarded the youngest one in such a way. Not only herself but also to her family and Tikan's comrades, Jin was such a person.
[You are also quite strong, how many times have you already blocked these fierce energies? Put more effort, the more devastating the trace, the better.]
"Yes, as you said, this is really a crisis, Guk!"
Mary rolled on the floor again and vomited blood.
"It's strange... Somehow, I don't think the youngest would keep getting fooled by this trick."
The Prophet's eyes narrowed.
Mary's eyes, which had quickly fallen into despair and darkened, began to regain their light.
As a prophet, no matter how you looked at it, it wasn’t a situation where Mary could have hope.
[Oh, are you going crazy in the face of such death in the end? That is a behavior that suits common and weak humans.]

"No, just... I just can't picture Jin being tricked by you guys. And we are not a pathetic prophecy faction like you, we are the record faction. By now, our recorder would have smelled something unpleasant, and someone among our comrades will be going to inform Jin......"
[Yes, yes. Whether you do or not, your body will soon be torn apart by the energy of the 12th flagbearer. You'll probably be able to hold on only a couple more times at most.]
Mary pushed away the energy manipulation and stood up.
Her legs were trembling as if she was about to collapse any moment, but her eyes were blazing fiercely.
"If you really think so, do you want to bet with me? I would bet that no one will die from Jin's energy. Twice? I can block it ten, even twenty times."
So if you want to see me die, come out yourself. Because I will never be defeated by Jin's energy.
Mary continued her words and glared at Irina.
